title: objectui.org has not deployed since 2026-09-06: every Vercel production build fails to resolve @object-ui/example-schema-catalog, because the dashboard build command stopped building it when #7986 removed apps/site's prebuild hook
body:
## What is broken

The live docs site **objectui.org is frozen at 2026-09-06**. Every production build of the Vercel project `objectui` (team `object-stack`, Root Directory `apps/site`) has failed since then, and every one of them is billed.

- Last READY production deployment: `dpl_3MdnDUaYt1eXkRBLUrXcy9D2frA6`, 2026-09-06 07:20 UTC, commit `6bfe358247`.
- First ERROR production deployment: `dpl_BZ1P3Ptn7GUGoe9inMScdPEBVeY2`, 2026-09-06 07:20 UTC, commit `bf914dc753` (#7986).
- Latest ERROR production deployment when this was filed: `dpl_2UdnxRkKxEUrSksvEQC7ikeG3w23`, 2026-10-12 02:07 UTC, commit `2498a07538` (the current tip of `main`).
- Read on 2026-10-12 from the Vercel API (`GET /v6/deployments?projectId=...&target=production&since=` the last READY): **2023 production deployments since the last READY one, all 2023 in state ERROR, one per `main` commit, median 4.6 build-minutes each, about 9,400 build-minutes in total.** That is a one-time reading, not a live count; re-run the same query to re-derive it.
- The maintainer's Vercel bill puts this project at roughly **USD 55/month**, almost all of it "Build CPU Minutes" spent on these failing builds. Nothing was deployed for that spend.

Log tail of `dpl_2UdnxRkKxEUrSksvEQC7ikeG3w23` (positions trimmed; the full log is `GET /v3/deployments/dpl_2UdnxRkKxEUrSksvEQC7ikeG3w23/events`):

```
Running "pnpm --filter '../../packages/*' -r build && pnpm build"
...
../../packages/app-shell build: Done
> @object-ui/site@3.1.0 build /vercel/path0/apps/site
> next build
▲ Next.js 16.3.6 (Turbopack)
> Build error occurred
Error: Turbopack build failed with 3 errors:
./apps/site/app/components/LiveSplitDemo.tsx
Error: Module not found: Can't resolve '@object-ui/example-schema-catalog'
./apps/site/app/components/SchemaCatalogIndex.tsx
Error: Module not found: Can't resolve '@object-ui/example-schema-catalog'
./apps/site/app/components/SchemaExample.tsx
Error: Module not found: Can't resolve '@object-ui/example-schema-catalog'
Error: Command "pnpm --filter '../../packages/*' -r build && pnpm build" exited with 1
```

The first failing deployment (`dpl_BZ1P3Ptn7GUGoe9inMScdPEBVeY2`) fails with the same three `Module not found` errors.

## Root cause

1. All three components import from `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` (`getExample` in SchemaExample.tsx and LiveSplitDemo.tsx, `allExamples` in SchemaCatalogIndex.tsx). That workspace package lives in `examples/schema-catalog`, and its `package.json` `exports["."]` points only at `./dist/index.js` / `./dist/index.d.ts`, which exist only after its `build` script (`tsc`) has run.
2. The Vercel project's **dashboard** build command is `pnpm --filter '../../packages/*' -r build && pnpm build`. The filter selects `packages/*` only, so it never builds `examples/schema-catalog`.
3. Until 2026-09-06 that gap was covered by a `prebuild` script in `apps/site/package.json`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/example-schema-catalog build`, which ran as the pre-hook of the second half of that command (`pnpm build` inside `apps/site`).
4. #7986 (`bf914dc753`, merged 2026-09-06 07:05 UTC) deleted that hook on purpose, making turbo's `build.dependsOn: ["^build"]` the only source of build order. Every path in the repo moved to the turbo form, including the root `site:build` script (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/site`). The Vercel dashboard command lives outside the repo, so it was not updated.
5. Result: on Vercel, `examples/schema-catalog/dist` never exists, and `next build` cannot resolve the package. The deployment boundary lines up exactly: the deployment for the commit before #7986 is READY, and the deployment for #7986 is the first ERROR.

## Why CI's `Build Docs` stays green on the same commit

CI does not build the same thing Vercel does. `ci.yml`'s `Build Docs` job runs `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/site'`. turbo builds the site's whole workspace dependency closure first, and `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` is a declared dependency of `@object-ui/site`, so turbo builds it. On `2498a07538`, the same commit as the latest failed Vercel deployment, push run 38194536766's `Build Docs` job built for real (`Tasks: 30 successful, 30 total`, `Cached: 7 cached, 30 total`, including `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog:build`) and passed. (#8647 is a different problem: there, `Build Docs` skipped the build on PRs. On `push` and `merge_group` runs it always builds.)

So a green `Build Docs` check has said nothing about the production deploy since 2026-09-06. The two use different commands, and only one of those commands is in the repo.

## Fix

Bring the deploy's build command into the repo and make it the command CI already runs: add `apps/site/vercel.json` (Vercel reads it from the project's Root Directory, and it overrides the dashboard values) with `buildCommand` `cd ../.. && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/site`, and keep `installCommand` at the current dashboard value, `pnpm i`. With that, CI's `Build Docs` and the deploy run the same command. The command also builds only the site's dependency closure instead of every package under `packages/`. That PR is linked below.

⛔ Restoring the `prebuild` hook is not the fix: #7986 removed hand-listed build chains on purpose, and the `turbo build inputs` guard keeps their number at zero.

Related, separately: moving the docs deploy into a GitHub Actions workflow (free on this public repo) and turning Vercel's Git-triggered builds off. That PR is also linked below.

Close this issue once a production deployment of the `objectui` project after the fix is READY and objectui.org shows post-2026-09-06 content. A merge on its own does not count.
